title: The highest percentage of recovery of stolen property was recorded in Tamil Nadu (56.4), followed by Rajasthan (53.5). Among the Union Territories, Delhi recorded a percentage of recovery of 42.3. The detailed statistics are exhibited in Appendices XXV to XXX Nautre of Property Stolen and Recovered : The statistics relating to certain types of property stolen and recovered are exhibited in Table 21. Similar details for States, Union Territories and Cities are presented in Appendices XXXI to XXXVI TABLE 22 NATURE OF PROPERTY STOLEN AND RECOVERED DURING 1969
